answer_4.quote: Two annotators independently reviewed all images according to five criteria: malformed rendering, anomalous or implausible elements, incorrect bounding boxes, inconsistent object states, and invalid spatial relations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to assess each image on five dimensions covering visual realism, object plausibility, grounding accuracy, and semantic consistency.
